topic: Bartolomeo bows to Luffy's ship because of one Loguetown lightning moment
title: Why Bartolomeo Bows Before Luffy's Ship Itself
description: Bartolomeo's ship-bowing scene looks like a gag, but it starts with one Loguetown moment. Here is the square where his loyalty began. Is his devotion sincere, or is it a joke the story keeps milking?
comment: Is Bartolomeo's devotion sincere loyalty, or is the fanboy act a joke the story keeps milking? Pick a side in the replies.

lines.text: Bartolomeo bowed to Luffy's ship, and it started in Loguetown.

shot.fallback: anime style, a green-haired pirate bowing before a wooden ship

lines.text: He was a feared crime boss, the most dangerous man in his town.

shot.fallback: anime style, a menacing crime boss in a dim street

lines.text: Then Buggy moved in on Luffy, with hundreds watching from the square.

shot.fallback: anime style, a clown pirate looming over a captive on a platform

lines.text: Lightning struck Buggy at that exact moment.

shot.fallback: anime style, lightning bolt hitting a clown pirate on a platform

lines.text: Luffy never flinched. He grinned at the edge of ruin.

shot.fallback: anime style, a straw hat pirate grinning defiantly on a platform

lines.text: Here's my read: that grin became the spark for everything after.

shot.fallback: anime style, a tough man staring at a grinning young pirate

lines.text: He chased his own dream after that, the way Luffy does.

shot.fallback: anime style, a green-haired pirate looking out over the open sea

lines.text: Years later, he kneels before the Thousand Sunny and weeps.

shot.fallback: anime style, a pirate kneeling in tears before a ship

lines.text: Nobody sensible does that. He meant every tear.

shot.fallback: anime style, a tearful pirate looking up at a crew on deck

lines.text: At Dressrosa, he entered the Colosseum for one reason.

shot.fallback: anime style, a fighter entering a huge colosseum

lines.text: To win Ace's old Mera Mera no Mi and give it to Luffy.

shot.search: Mera Mera no Mi Bartolomeo Luffy
shot.fallback: anime style, a glowing flame-themed devil fruit on a pedestal

lines.text: Think about that gift. He wasn't chasing power for himself.

shot.fallback: anime style, a fighter holding a glowing fruit with resolve

lines.text: His whole loyalty was built on one boy's refusal to look afraid.

shot.fallback: anime style, a loyal pirate beside a defiant captain

lines.text: A feared boss bowed to a ship because a boy refused to look afraid.

shot.fallback: anime style, a pirate bowing before a ship at sunset

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Bartolomeo and the ship bow, with a Loguetown hook
self_check.loop: Last line leads back into line 1 about the bow and Loguetown
